camel_example: aliyun maxcompute GET /api/v1/projects/autoCluster/suggestion --region cn-hangzhou --date 20251123 --pageNumber 1 --sortField score --pageSize 10 --order true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Performs a paged query on the clustering suggestions for tables of the current tenant in the current region. The paging results show the recommended cluster keys, bucketing count, recommendation score, and estimated data volume of saved shuffle data
description_zh: 分页查询当前租户在当前地域各表的聚簇建议，查看推荐的聚簇键、分桶数、推荐指数和预估可节省的 Shuffle 数据量
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute list-auto-cluster-suggestion --date 20251123 --sort-field score --order true --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2022-01-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAutoClusterSuggestion

parameters.help_en: The date of the analysis batch in the yyyyMMdd format. If this parameter is not specified, the latest batch of the corresponding dataset is used
parameters.help_zh: 分析批次日期，格式为 yyyyMMdd。不传时使用对应数据集的最新批次
parameters.name: date

parameters.help_en: The sort field. Valid values: score, savedShuffle, and bucketNum. Default value: score
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。支持 `score`、`savedShuffle`、`bucketNum`。默认使用 `score`
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. A value of true indicates ascending order, and a value of false indicates descending order. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。true 为升序，false 为降序。默认为 false
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始。默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

data.description_en: The automatic clustering suggestions for the tenant
data.description_zh: 列出租户的自动聚簇建议的结果

autoClusterList.description_en: The list of automatic clustering records on the current page
autoClusterList.description_zh: 本页的自动聚簇记录列表

benefitJobCount.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is deprecated and is no longer returned. Do not rely on this field. The example is provided only to illustrate the data type
benefitJobCount.description_zh: 已废弃，当前不返回，请勿依赖。示例仅用于说明类型

bucketNum.description_en: The number of buckets in the cluster

clusterKey.description_en: The list of cluster key column names

items.description_en: The column name of a cluster key

clusterType.description_en: The recommended cluster type. A value of hash indicates a hash cluster
clusterType.description_zh: 推荐的聚簇类型。hash 表示哈希聚簇

date.description_en: The observation interval used to generate the suggestion. The returned value starts with the number of observation days
date.description_zh: 生成该建议时使用的观测区间。返回值以观测天数开头

project.description_en: The name of the MaxCompute project

savedCu.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is deprecated and is no longer returned. Do not rely on this field. The example is provided only to illustrate the data type
savedCu.description_zh: 已废弃，当前不返回，请勿依赖。示例仅用于说明类型

savedShuffle.description_en: The estimated net volume of saved shuffle data, in GB. This value is calculated by subtracting the increased data volume on the write side from the saved data volume on the read side
savedShuffle.description_zh: 预估净节省的 Shuffle 数据量，单位为 GB。按读取侧节省量减去写入侧增加量计算

savedTime.description_en: [Deprecated] This field is deprecated and is no longer returned. Do not rely on this field. The example is provided only to illustrate the data type
savedTime.description_zh: 已废弃，当前不返回，请勿依赖。示例仅用于说明类型

schema.description_en: The name of the schema to which the table belongs
schema.description_zh: 表所属的 Schema 名称

score.description_en: The recommendation score. The base score is 5. Points are deducted based on related jobs and observation data. A higher score indicates a higher priority for review
score.description_zh: 推荐指数。以 5 分为基准，根据相关作业和观测数据扣分，分数越高越值得优先查看

sortKey.description_en: The list of sort column names in the cluster
sortKey.description_zh: 聚簇内的排序列名列表

items.description_en: The column name of a sort key

table.description_en: The name of the MaxCompute table

pageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
pageNumber.description_zh: 页码，从 1 开始。默认值为 1

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 匹配当前查询条件的记录总数

errorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
errorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

errorMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
errorMsg.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息

httpCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request
httpCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this identifier to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的唯一标识。排查调用问题时可提供该标识
